cases.question: Among schools with a school-level SAT excellence rate above 0.3, what is the highest ages-5-17 free-meal eligibility rate?
cases.evidence: SAT excellence rate is the share of test takers scoring at least 1500.

cases.question: For locally funded schools whose K-12 minus ages-5-17 enrollment difference exceeds the average such difference among locally funded schools, list each school's directory-listed name and DOC type.
For the five schools with ownership code 66 and the largest K-12 free-or-reduced-price meal counts, give each school's K-12 eligible meal rate rounded to six decimal places.
What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange County to merged Elementary School District schools?
What are the mailing street address and name of the school with the seventh-highest recorded average mathematics score?
How many non-charter schools in Los Angeles County have a K-12 free-meal percentage below 0.18%?
Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the county of Los Angeles and what is its Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)?
cases.evidence: FRPM eligibility percentage is free-or-reduced-price meal recipients divided by same-age-band enrollment, times 100.

cases.question: What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by an administrator whose first name is Alusine. List the district code of the school.
cases.evidence: K-12 free-meal eligibility percentage is K-12 free-meal recipients divided by K-12 enrollment, times 100.

cases.question: List the distinct available administrator email addresses for public intermediate/middle schools in San Bernardino city and county, in a unified school district, opened during 2009 or 2010.

I'm comparing three high schools in Alameda County and want to focus on the one with the biggest student body. The schools have these CDS codes: 1751010130583, 1612910137588, and 1611760134270. Which of these three schools has the highest enrollment of students aged 5-17? Please give me the 5-digit NCES school identification number for that school. If two or more of them tie for the highest enrollment, give me the NCES identification number of each tied school.
cases.evidence: NCES school identification number: the 5-digit school-level NCES identifier. Enrollment (Ages 5-17): the number of students aged 5 through 17 enrolled at the school.

cases.question: I'm profiling the High Tech High charter network in San Diego. For charter number 756, what is the average number of SAT test takers per school across all of its schools with a San Diego mailing city? Count every school regardless of operational status, and treat a school with no SAT record as having zero test takers. Round the average to two decimals.
cases.evidence: Charter number 756 is the state-issued charter number.

cases.question: Following up on the SAT participation review: among the currently operating high schools in the district with NCES identification number 0613360 that had no SAT test takers, which one begins serving students at the earliest grade? Please give me each such school's name and grade span served. Note that a high school must actually enroll students through grade 12-offering grade 12 without enrollment doesn't count. A school with no SAT record counts as having zero SAT test takers and should be included; only exclude schools with a positive number of SAT test takers. Compare starting grades as school grades-preschool comes before kindergarten, which comes before grade 1-and use the lowest grade the school actually serves, not just what it offers. If several schools tie at the earliest grade, list them all alphabetically by school name.
cases.evidence: NCES identification number 0613360 is the school district identification number assigned by the National Center for Education Statistics.

cases.question: I'm profiling schools run directly by the California State Board of Education. Which of those schools has the highest average SAT reading score? If several tie for the highest, give me all of them. For each school, I need its name and its full mailing street address - the complete address, not an abbreviated one. Only include schools the State Board runs directly, and the score must be the school's own result, not a district-wide figure.
cases.evidence: State Board of Education: the state authority that directly runs and oversees certain California schools.

cases.question: I'm trying to verify where a school I was told about is located. It's a high school in Alameda County with Breakfast Provision 2 status, serving grades 9 through 12, and its identification number is 1611920113902. What city is this school in?
cases.evidence: The identification number is the school's CDS code; Educational Instruction Level Code 'HS' identifies a high school; grades 9 through 12 means lowest grade 9 and highest grade 12; Breakfast Provision 2 is a National School Lunch Program provision status.

cases.question: I'm reviewing NSLP Provision 2 schools. Can you give me the name and city of every high school (educational instruction level code HS) whose meal-program status is exactly Provision 2 and whose lowest grade served is above ninth grade? One row per school, ordered by school name. Note: only the status named Provision 2 counts-the breakfast and lunch variants are separate statuses and shouldn't be included.

I'm profiling California's statewide benefit charter networks. Among the schools run by a statewide benefit charter network, which single school had the highest number of SAT test takers who scored 1500 or above? Please give me that school's name and its phone number. If several schools tie for the highest count, list every tied school with its phone number.
cases.evidence: Statewide benefit charter: a charter school network authorized directly by the California State Board of Education to operate schools throughout the state; charter schools authorized by a school district or county office of education are not statewide benefit charters.

cases.question: I'm looking at a directly-funded charter high school in California with CDS code 1611190130609. Could you tell me its average SAT math score and how many students took the SAT there? Just that one school's figures. If the school with that CDS code turns out not to be directly funded, then there's no answer.
cases.evidence: CDS code: the identification number the California Department of Education assigns to a county, district, or school. Directly-funded charter school: a charter school that receives its funding directly from the state rather than through its district.

cases.question: I'm looking at SAT participation in Contra Costa County. How many schools in the county had more SAT test takers than the school with CDS code 7618040730051? That school is itself a Contra Costa County school, so I just want the count of schools strictly ahead of it by number of SAT test takers, based on the SAT results snapshot in the data. A single number is all I need.
cases.evidence: CDS code: the County-District-School identifier that the California Department of Education assigns to each school and district in the state.

cases.question: I'm comparing schools in San Francisco. How many public schools with a San Francisco mailing city had an average total SAT score of at least 1500? Please count only schools whose district type is 'Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', or 'County Office of Education (COE)' - exclude any other district type. I just need the single count of qualifying schools.
cases.evidence: A school's total SAT score is the sum of its average reading, average math, and average writing scores; a school's mailing city is the city in its mailing address.

cases.question: What is the lowest grade level at which any school in our district begins serving students? If several schools tie at the lowest grade, just report that single grade level for the whole district. Our district is NCES district ID 0632640.
cases.evidence: 'P' stands for preschool.

cases.question: I'm reviewing administrator coverage across Amador and Madera counties, and I want to see which administrator first names actually cover the most schools. For the two administrator first names whose holders run the most schools across the two counties (ranking names by the number of schools their holders run, with the alphabetically earlier name ranking higher if two names run equally many schools), please give me one row per public school district in those two counties and per those two first names, showing the district name, the first name, and the number of schools in that district run by an administrator with that first name - including every public school district, even ones where that's zero. Every administrator listed for a school counts, not just the first-listed one. A public school district means a unified school district, an elementary school district, a high school district, or a county office of education, and only Amador and Madera counties are in scope.

For the 2014-2015 academic year, what was the average number of enrolled students aged 5 to 17 eligible for free or reduced price meals per Youth Authority school? Count every Youth Authority school regardless of its status (active, closed, or merged), and treat a Youth Authority school with no meal-program record as zero. Please give me just that one number, rounded to two decimal places.
cases.evidence: A Youth Authority school is a school the state directory classifies as a Youth Authority Facility.

cases.question: I have a school's CDS code from a separate list of Alameda County schools on Breakfast Provision 2, and I need to confirm which school it is. For the school with CDS code 1612590136051, please give me the school name and the educational instruction level name. This CDS code identifies exactly one school, so return only that school.
cases.evidence: Breakfast Provision 2: the NSLP provision status category the school participates in. CDS code 1612590136051: the school identifier being asked about.

cases.question: I'm looking at the schools that the State Board of Education directly runs or charters. Which individual school among them had the most students score at least 1500 on the SAT? Please give me that school's name and its administrator's email address. If two schools tie on that count, list both.
cases.evidence: Schools run or chartered by the State Board of Education are identified by their district ownership type.

cases.question: We're relocating to far Northern California and want to know how far north California's middle schools reach. A middle school means a school serving the middle grades, the level between elementary school and high school — count it as a middle school if either its school type or its school name marks it as serving the middle grades, so a junior high school whose name says 'Middle' counts. Include both open and closed schools. Please tell me which middle school is located furthest north in California, along with its school type (the value of the field named 'School Type'), its school name, and its latitude in degrees. If several middle schools tie for the highest latitude, list all of them.
cases.evidence: middle school: a school serving the middle grades, the level between elementary school and high school

cases.question: I'm working on a story about campuses Los Angeles County opened during 2007 and the SAT participation they drew. What was the average number of SAT test takers per school across Los Angeles County schools that opened during 2007 and are run by a school district? Please give me that single number, rounded to two decimals. A few things to keep in mind: a county office of education counts as the school district for the schools it runs; "opened during 2007" means the opening date falls in calendar year 2007; and a school with no SAT record counts as zero test takers.
cases.evidence: SAT test takers: the number of test takers recorded for the school.

cases.question: I'm reviewing charter school funding models and want to compare the directly funded and locally funded charters that are currently in operation. For each of the two funding categories, please give me: (1) the number of charter schools currently in operation, counting only schools the directory lists as active (open), not closed or merged; (2) total 2014-2015 K-12 enrollment; (3) the average percentage of students eligible for free or reduced-price meals, on a 0-100 scale, rounded to two decimals; and (4) the average combined SAT score (reading + math + writing) across schools that have reported scores, rounded to two decimals. Note that schools without SAT results should still count in the school count, enrollment total, and meal-eligibility average. Please give me these figures grouped by funding category.
cases.evidence: Directly funded and locally funded are the two charter funding categories. Free or reduced-price meal eligibility is measured by the K-12 eligible percentage. Combined SAT score is the sum of the average reading, math and writing scores.

cases.question: Among California's state special schools, which one begins enrolling students at the latest grade level? Please give me: the school's name, the earliest grade level covered by its K-12 enrollment, its K-12 enrollment, and how many SAT test takers it had. In the grade-level codes, P means pre-kindergarten and K means kindergarten, and grades progress from pre-kindergarten to kindergarten to grades 1 through 12 — so a school starting at grade 1 starts later than one starting at kindergarten. If a state special school has no SAT record, still consider it a candidate and report it as having 0 SAT test takers. If two schools start at the same grade level, prefer the one with the larger K-12 enrollment; if still tied, the one whose name comes first alphabetically. The data is for the 2014-2015 school year.
cases.evidence: A state special school is a school operated by the state of California that serves students with special needs, such as the schools for the deaf or the blind.

cases.question: I'm putting together a brief on SAT participation among California's larger public schools. How many individual named school sites in the state with a K-12 enrollment over 500 and a highest grade served of 8 or below had no SAT test takers? I just need the school_count, a single whole number. Please count a school as an individual school site with a name - district and county offices of education are not schools. Include every qualifying school site statewide even if it shows no SAT results at all; such a site simply had no test takers. By highest grade served I mean the top grade level the school serves, as a grade number from 1 through 12.

I'm studying charter schools run by county offices of education. Using the K-12 school meal program records, for the charter schools these county offices operate, broken down by charter funding type (directly funded and locally funded only), I'd like to know: how many are currently operating, their total K-12 enrollment, and their total number of FRPM-eligible K-12 students. A school counts as currently operating only if its status is Active. Please give me one row per funding type, with directly funded first.
cases.evidence: FRPM means free or reduced price meal eligibility.

cases.question: I'm documenting now-closed California schools whose students performed best on the SAT writing section, and I need the runner-up. Among schools whose status is Closed (not Active, Merged or Pending), and which have an average SAT writing score, can you tell me which school had the second-highest average SAT writing score? By second-highest I mean the best score strictly below the highest – if several schools share that score, please list them all. For each school, give me its name, its own district and county, and its average SAT writing score.
cases.evidence: SAT writing score: the average writing score of the school's SAT test takers.

cases.question: I'm a parent looking at high schools in California, and I want to know how often a school that's still open has no seniors taking the SAT at all. How many currently open public high schools in California had zero students take the SAT? By 'currently open' I mean the school's status is Active, not closed or merged. By 'high school' I mean a school whose educational instruction level is High School. Please count a school that has no SAT record at all as having zero test takers. I just want that one number.
cases.evidence: SAT test takers: the number of test takers recorded for the school in the SAT scores data.

cases.question: I'm planning a targeted meal-support pilot and want to compare one school against similar schools in our county. The county I mean is the one where Fremont High (CDS code 1612590125716) is located - please identify the county by that CDS code, not by the school name. For that county, please look at all K-12 schools with more than 500 free meals and fewer than 700 FRPM meals, and give me back: the county name; the number of schools; the average free-meal percentage and the average FRPM percentage, both on a 0-100 scale with each school's own percentage rounded to 2 decimals before averaging; the number of charter schools and the number of non-charter schools (charter vs. non-charter per the charter indicator in the frpm data); and the average SAT score, where a school's SAT score is the sum of its three SAT section averages, counted only for schools that actually have SAT records, with no SAT record meaning the school is simply excluded from that average. Please round the reported averages to 2 decimals.
cases.evidence: Free meal percentage = free meal count (K-12) / enrollment (K-12) * 100; FRPM percentage = FRPM count (K-12) / enrollment (K-12) * 100; charter school = charter indicator 1, non-charter = charter indicator 0.

cases.question: I'm studying the 1980 growth of public schooling in San Diego County. What was the average number of schools per month that opened in San Diego County in 1980 under a school district's jurisdiction? I need just that single number. Please average over all 12 months of 1980 (months with no openings count as zero), and give me the exact average without rounding.
cases.evidence: A school district is a local education agency that runs K-12 public schools; it is an elementary school district, a high school district, or a unified school district.

cases.question: Among California schools whose students have an average SAT Math score above 400, what percentage offer virtual instruction, either exclusively or in part? Please give me a single percentage value rounded to one decimal place.
cases.evidence: In the school directory, the exclusive-virtual category is coded 'F' and the partial-virtual category is coded 'P'.

cases.question: A parent is asking about a school and could only give me the CDS code 1612590137943. Can you look up that school and give me its name, county, district, and city; its K-12 enrollment; the number of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced price meals and the percentage eligible (report the percentage exactly as it appears, without rounding); and the SAT results - number of test takers, average reading score, average math score, average writing score, and the number of test takers whose total score is at least 1500?
cases.evidence: CDS code: the state's County-District-School identification code assigned to each school; FRPM: the Free or Reduced Price Meal program, where the FRPM count is the number of students eligible.

cases.question: I'm putting together a profile of Alameda County high schools, focusing on economic disadvantage among schools that serve up through 12th grade. Among those schools, can you tell me which one has the highest free meal rate? For each school you identify, give me one line with: the school name, its free meal rate to 4 decimal places, whether it is a charter school (Yes/No/Unknown), the grades it serves, and its SAT performance level (Below Average, Average, Above Average, or No SAT Data). Please use the school's grade span of enrollment from the school directory (the GSserved field of the schools table) both to decide whether it serves up through 12th grade and for the grades-it-serves column-do not use the free-meal program record's Low Grade/High Grade for either. If several schools tie for the highest free meal rate, list every one of them.
cases.evidence: Free meal rate = Free Meal Count (K-12) / Enrollment (K-12). SAT performance level is based on the SAT total (Reading + Math + Writing): Below Average if below 1200, Average if 1200 to 1500, Above Average if above 1500, and 'No SAT Data' if no SAT scores are available.

cases.question: Could you pull a full profile for the school with CDS code 7618040113118? I need its name, phone number, website, average SAT reading, math and writing scores, whether it is a charter school, its K-12 enrollment for the 2014-2015 academic year, and the percentage of its students eligible for free or reduced price meals on a 0-100 scale rounded to two decimal places. Alongside that, please find the highest average SAT math score achieved by any active school with at least 10 SAT test takers – if several schools tie for the highest, just give me that single score – and how far below that highest score this school's math score falls.
cases.evidence: CDS code is the California Department of Education's school identifier; a charter school is one with charter status recorded as 1.

cases.question: I'm mapping where exclusively virtual schools are concentrated. For the five counties with the most exclusively virtual schools - if several counties tie with the fifth-highest count, include all of them - please give me for each county: the county name, how many exclusively virtual schools it has, and the name of the exclusively virtual school in that county with the highest average SAT reading score. If several schools tie for the highest average reading score in a county, list each of them. If none of the county's exclusively virtual schools has a reported reading average, show 'None' as the school name.
cases.evidence: An exclusively virtual school is one whose Virtual field holds the code 'F'.

cases.question: I'm comparing online-only schooling options. I'd like to know, for Santa Barbara County and for the county that contains the school with CDS code 1100170109835 (which identifies one school), how many exclusive-virtual schools are in each county. Please give me each county's name with its number of exclusive-virtual schools, listing the county with the larger number first, or alphabetically by county name if they tie.
cases.evidence: A school counts as exclusive-virtual only if its virtual-instruction category is coded 'F'.

cases.question: I'm studying how concentrated economic need relates to SAT outcomes in California public schools. Among regular, non-charter schools with more than 100 K-12 students, I'd like two extremes plus one benchmark school: the school with the largest count of FRPM-eligible students, the school with the smallest FRPM share (the proportion of its K-12 enrollment that is FRPM-eligible – smallest by that share, not the raw count), and the school with CDS code 4615150435602 from my notes. If a school answers more than one part, report it once per part, and label each row with which part it answers ('largest FRPM-eligible count', 'smallest FRPM share', or 'the CDS code from my notes', in that order). Include ties. For each school, please give: school name, county, city, full mailing address as four columns (mailing street, mailing city, mailing state, mailing ZIP), website, K-12 enrollment, FRPM-eligible student count, FRPM share, average total SAT score (reading + math + writing) among its SAT takers, percentage of its SAT takers scoring 1500 or more, opening date, and status ('closed' if a closing date is recorded, otherwise 'open'). Nothing else, please.
cases.evidence: CDS code: the California Department of Education's identification code for a school; the benchmark school in my notes is identified by CDS code 4615150435602.

cases.question: I'm auditing FRPM enrollment reporting and need to contact some elementary and middle schools. Please list the name and street address of every named school whose K-12 enrollment exceeds its enrollment of students aged 5-17 by more than 30 students, and whose highest grade of enrollment is grade 8 or below. Kindergarten counts as grade 8 or below. Give me one row per school; any order is fine.
cases.evidence: K-12 enrollment is enrollment counted for kindergarten through grade 12. Enrollment of ages 5-17 is enrollment counted for students aged 5 through 17. Highest grade of enrollment is the highest grade level the school enrolls students in (e.g., grade 8 for a school serving kindergarten through grade 8).

cases.question: I'm auditing high-school-level campuses that draw enrollments beyond their surrounding school-age population. Can you give me a list of schools where the K-12 enrollment exceeds the ages-5-17 enrollment by more than 30, limited to schools whose lowest served grade is grade 9 or a later grade (a school's lowest served grade being the low end of the grade range reported in the same enrollment record as its K-12 and ages-5-17 counts)? For each school, I just need the school name and street address. Please order the results by the school's CDS code, smallest first.
cases.evidence: CDS code: a school's identifier in the California schools data.

cases.question: I'm researching where high SAT performance coexists with concentrated poverty, to help target college-access support by county. For the 2014-15 academic year, for each county, how many schools had both a K-12 free-meal eligibility rate above 0.1 and at least one SAT taker scoring 1500 or higher on the school's own SAT record? Please list only counties that have at least one such school, with the county name and the number of its qualifying schools, sorted from most such schools to fewest, and alphabetically by county name when counties tie.
cases.evidence: K-12 free-meal eligibility rate: the share of a school's K-12 enrollment that is eligible for free meals (free meal count divided by K-12 enrollment).

cases.question: I have a school on file with CDS code 1611430131177. Find the school in the same county as that school whose own SAT record shows the most students scoring at least 1500 (not a district-wide roll-up). If two schools tie on that count, use the one with the smaller CDS code. Send me that school's administrator's first and last name.
cases.evidence: CDS code: the County-District-School identifier assigned to each school; scoring at least 1500: a test taker whose combined SAT score is 1500 or higher.

cases.question: I'm working on a story about the largest schools in the state with the worst SAT excellence rates. Among schools where at least 700 students took the SAT, can you find the school with the lowest SAT excellence rate? If several schools tie for the lowest rate, go with the one with the smallest school code. I just need that school's street, city, ZIP code and state so I can visit and request an interview.
cases.evidence: The SAT excellence rate is the share of SAT test takers scoring at least 1500. A school code is a number.

cases.question: I'm planning reviews of Provision 2 meal programs under the NSLP and want to see which cities concentrate magnet schools under that provision. For each city that has at least one, can you give me the number of the city's magnet schools that run a Provision 2 meal program? Use the city where the school is located, not its mailing city. Also, if a school's NSLP entry lists multiple provision types, don't count it as running Provision 2.
cases.evidence: NSLP is the National School Lunch Program. Provision 2 is a federal provision under the NSLP that lets a school serve meals at no charge to all students regardless of family income.

cases.question: I'm preparing a mailing campaign and need a list of public high schools in Los Angeles County that have more than 500 free or reduced-price meal recipients ages 5-17. By public high schools I mean every public high-school category in the meal program report - regular high schools, continuation high schools, and high schools in single-school districts - not just regular ones; middle and junior high schools don't count. For each school, please give me the school name exactly as listed in the school directory, plus the campus (physical) street address - not a mailing or post-office address - along with the city, state and ZIP code, each as a separate field. Schools sharing a name are separate schools, so one row per school. Please sort the list by school name.
cases.evidence: 'Free or reduced-price meal recipients ages 5-17' refers to the count reported in the meal program report for students ages 5-17 receiving free or reduced-price meals.

cases.question: I'd like to compare SAT participation across counties in California that run magnet schools under Provision 2 of the National School Lunch Program. For every county with at least one Provision 2 magnet school, can you give me the county name and the total number of SAT test takers from those schools? Please include every such county even if the total is 0, and list them in any order.
cases.evidence: Provision 2 school: a school whose NSLP Provision Status is Provision 2. Magnet school: a school identified as a magnet school or providing a magnet program.

cases.question: List the IDs of borderless card printings for which Card Kingdom lacks a regular-version listing or a foil-version listing.
Which distinct combinations of card name, artist, and promotional-printing flag occur among the printings tied for the most rulings?
What percentage of all card printings have a Simplified Chinese translation? Round to two decimals.
What rules text is printed on Benalish Knight? Return the distinct text as one line.
Among all Story Spotlight card printings, what percentage have a French translation? Round to two decimals.
What are the cards belong to duel deck a? List the ID.
How many distinct white-bordered card printings are banned in at least one play format?
How many distinct card printings with no recorded power value or a variable power expression have at least one ruling mentioning 'triggered ability'?
cases.evidence: An asterisk anywhere in a power expression denotes variable power.

cases.question: What percentage of cards with format commander and legal status do not have a content warning?
Among card printings with no recorded power value or a variable power expression, what percentage have a French translation? Round to two decimals.
cases.evidence: An asterisk anywhere in a power expression denotes variable power.

cases.question: Among the sets in the block "Ice Age", how many of them have an Italian translation?
What percentage of Coldsnap card printings have both a Card Kingdom regular-product ID and foil-product ID recorded?
Which play format has the most banned card-printing records? Give that format and the distinct names of its banned cards.
I collect promotional printings and play Brawl. How many different creature cards that have a promotional printing can serve as a Brawl commander? I just want a single number back.
cases.evidence: A promotional printing is a printing of a card made as a promotion, as opposed to a regular set printing. Brawl is a Magic: The Gathering format; the deck's commander is the card that leads it, and only certain cards are legal as a Brawl commander.

cases.question: I'm cataloguing how the frame styles on Tarmogoyf's printings evolved over time. What is the number of years between the oldest and the newest frame style used on the printings of Tarmogoyf? The span in years is the newer year minus the older year.
cases.evidence: Frame style version means the year a card's frame style dates from.

cases.question: How many black-border cards with power 10 or greater are available on Magic: The Gathering Online? I just want a single number.
cases.evidence: Black-border cards are the tournament-legal Magic cards, excluding the joke silver-bordered sets. Power is the first number in the lower-right corner of a creature card.

cases.question: I have the count of sets with fewer than five translations of their name — now I need the gap in cards to size the translation budget. Can you give me the total number of cards contained in those sets? A few things to keep in mind: 'fewer than five' is strict, so a set with exactly five translations doesn't count. All sets count regardless of type or release (core set, expansion, promotional, online-only, etc.). If two languages have the identical translated name string for a set, that's one translation, not two. And a set's card count should be its full size, including promotional and related supplemental printings.
cases.evidence: A 'translation of a set's name' means the localized name of the set in another language, e.g. its French or Simplified Chinese name.

cases.question: I'm preparing a multilingual catalog and want to gauge how much localizable content exists per kind of set. For every set type, I need the number of sets of that type that have an officially translated name, and the total number of cards in those sets. Please include every set type in the results, even ones where no set has an officially translated name (show zero for both values in that case), and sort the results alphabetically by set type.
cases.evidence: Set type: the expansion type of a set, such as core, expansion or promo. Officially translated name: the set's name rendered in another language, such as Italian or Chinese Traditional.

cases.question: How many rulings were issued for Mishra's Factory on the latest date any ruling for it exists? By "latest date" I mean the most recent calendar date on which any ruling for the card exists, and by Mishra's Factory I mean the card by that name across all of its printings. I only want that count.
cases.evidence: ruling: an official rules statement issued for a card on a given date

cases.question: Which artist has illustrated the most different creature cards, and how many different creature cards is that? I'd like each artist's name along with their count of different creature cards. If two artists are tied for the most, list both.
cases.evidence: A creature card is a card whose card types include Creature.

cases.question: I'm putting together a showcase of zero-mana-cost cards. What is the newest frame version used by any card with a converted mana cost of 0? Please give me that frame version value, and the number of cards in the database that use that frame version. The count should cover all cards in the database, not just the zero-cost ones. If several frame versions tie as the newest, give me each of them with its own count.
cases.evidence: Frame version: the edition of the card frame style a printing uses.

cases.question: I'm tracking printings of Tarmogoyf. Of all its printings, which frame version is the newest? Please give me the year that identifies that latest frame version, and the percentage of the card's printings that use it, rounded to two decimal places. The percentage should be over all printings of the card.
cases.evidence: A printing is an occurrence of the card in a set; a frame version is the version of the card frame style of a printing.

cases.question: I'm building an artifact-heavy Commander deck and want to know the size of the pool of zero-cost cards available to me. How many different cards have a printed mana cost of {0} and are legal in Commander? A card is legal in Commander if its Commander legality entry is marked Legal.
cases.evidence: Printed mana cost of 0 means the cost shown on the card is {0}. Commander is a format of play in which any card marked Legal for that format is playable.

cases.question: I'm brewing and looking for cards that combine two keyword abilities. How many cards in the collection have both Flying and Cycling? Note that each printing counts as its own card, and a card only counts if it has both keywords.
cases.evidence: Flying and Cycling are keyword abilities in Magic: The Gathering.

cases.question: I'm comparing how mana-cheap Magic: The Gathering sets have become over time. For two sets — the set where Abyssal Horror was first printed, and the most recently released set in the database — I want one row per set with the set name and the percentage of that set's cards that have a mana cost whose converted mana cost is 3 or less, rounded to two decimal places. By "first printed", I mean the set with the earliest release date among the sets Abyssal Horror appears in; if several share that earliest date, use the one whose set code comes first alphabetically. For the most recent set, use the latest release date among all sets; if several share that date, again take the one whose set code comes first alphabetically. By "converted mana cost" I mean the card's mana value, and a card counts as having a mana cost only if a mana cost is printed on it.
cases.evidence: Converted mana cost means the card's mana value; a card has a mana cost when a mana cost is printed on the card.

cases.question: How many different cards have ever been printed as a release promotion? I just need a single number, covering all printings across the game's entire history with no time restriction. Note that a prerelease printing is a different promotion type and shouldn't be counted as a release promotion.
cases.evidence: A release promotion is a promotional printing whose promotion type is 'release'.

cases.question: I'm cataloguing the Abzan clan's cards and need this: among the cards with the Abzan watermark, which one comes last in its set's numbering - i.e. has the highest collector number? Please give me the card's name, its collector number, and how many foreign-language printings exist for that card. If several Abzan-watermarked cards tie for the highest collector number, list every one of them, each with its own count of foreign-language printings. Count each foreign-language edition record of the card as one printing.
cases.evidence: Abzan watermark: the clan mark printed on the card. Collector number: the number of the card within the set it was printed in. Foreign-language printing: the foreign-language edition record of a card.

cases.question: I'm profiling the weak end of the white-bordered printings. How many white-bordered cards have a power less than 3? I just need that single count - only white-bordered cards are in scope, and please don't include anything else in the answer.
cases.evidence: Power is a card's combat strength. A card whose power is shown as * has no known power.

cases.question: I'm putting together a showcase of instant-speed cards from Magic: The Gathering. Which cards in the Dark Ascension set have the Flash keyword and, among those, the highest converted mana cost? Please list just the card names, one row per card, alphabetically by name, and include every card that ties on that highest cost.
cases.evidence: Dark Ascension is the Magic: The Gathering set named 'Dark Ascension'. Flash is the keyword that lets a card be cast any time you could cast an instant. Converted mana cost is the total amount of mana a card costs to cast.

cases.question: I'm preparing localized set icon assets and need to know the foreign-language name coverage of every Magic: The Gathering set released in 2020. For each set released in 2020 (meaning its release date falls within the calendar year 2020), please give me the set's name, its keyrune code, and the number of languages in which the set has an official translated name. Nothing else.
cases.evidence: keyrune code: the code for the set's image icon; official translated name: the set's name rendered in a foreign language by the game's publisher.

cases.question: I'm sizing a catalogue page of 2017 sets that were localized for international markets. How many cards were there in total across the Magic: The Gathering sets released in 2017 (between January 1 and December 31, 2017) that have a name in a language other than English? A set counts as localized if its name has a foreign-language translation. Include every card in each qualifying set, counting promotional and related supplemental printings as part of the set. I just need the single total across all qualifying sets, not per-set numbers.
cases.evidence: A foreign-language translation is a set's name rendered in a language other than English (e.g. Chinese Simplified, German, Spanish).

cases.question: I've already looked at the heavy hitters in duel deck B (the 'b' deck). Now I want to check the light end: how many cards in duel deck B are not available in foil and have attack power below 3? Note that 'below 3' means strictly below 3 — a power of exactly 3 doesn't count.

I'm writing a spotlight piece on card artists, and I need to know: among black-bordered cards that are obtainable on Magic Arena and have a printed power of 10 or greater, which artist illustrated the most of them? Please give me the artist's name and the number of those cards they illustrated. A card counts even if it's also available outside Arena, as long as it can be obtained on Arena. If several artists tie for the most, list every one of them along with that count.
cases.evidence: Black border means the card's border color is black; power is the combat strength printed on a creature card, and '10 or greater' means the printed power reads as a number that is at least 10 (10, 11, 12, and so on).

cases.question: I'm going through my paper collection before sharing it publicly, and I want to check something about the cards Wizards of the Coast has flagged. How many different cards are there that carry a sensitive content warning, are available in paper form, and have never been available on Magic Online (MTGO)? I just need that one count.
cases.evidence: MTGO means Magic: The Gathering Online, the official online version of the game. A sensitive content warning means Wizards of the Coast has marked the card for having sensitive content.

cases.question: Hi! I'm preparing a licensing brief for our Japanese partner about Magic: The Gathering localization coverage. Could you pull a report of every expansion type (core, expansion, promo, etc.), showing for each one how many sets of that type carry a Japanese name entry? A Japanese name entry means the set's name-translations include a Japanese-language entry giving the set's name in Japanese. Please include every expansion type in the report even if none of its sets have such an entry (show 0 for those), and sort the results alphabetically by expansion type. Nothing else needed - just the expansion type and the count.
cases.evidence: Japanese name entry: an entry in the set's name-translations whose language is Japanese and which gives the set's name in Japanese.

cases.question: I'm cataloguing Arena-exclusive illustrated art of big creatures. How many artists have illustrated at least one black-bordered card that is available on Arena but never on Magic Online and has a fixed printed power of at least 5? I want just the number of artists, nothing else. Count across all printings in the collection with no time restriction. Note that a card whose power varies is not a fixed number, so it shouldn't count as power 5 or more.
cases.evidence: Arena and Magic Online are online platforms; a card's availability lists every platform it can be played on: 'arena' is Arena and 'mtgo' is Magic Online. Power is the attack strength printed on a creature card. Black-bordered refers to the standard card border color black.

cases.question: I collect trading cards, and one of my favorites is Ancestor's Chosen. Of all the sets that include this card, look at the one released most recently - if several sets share that latest release date, consider them together. How many creature cards in that set (or sets) have power greater than toughness? I just want that single count, nothing else.
cases.evidence: Power is the attack strength printed on a creature card; toughness is the defense strength printed on a creature card.

cases.question: Among the Commander-leadable cards that the Card Kingdom catalog lists for both a foil printing and a regular non-foil printing – cards listed for only one of the two printings don't count – I want the single most recent card frame year (the latest calendar year among the frame versions), and the count of cards in that group whose frame version is that year. Please return just that one row: the frame year and its card count.
cases.evidence: A card 'may lead a Commander deck' if it can be the deck's commander – the one card that leads the deck and sets its color identity – not merely be included among the deck's other cards.

cases.question: I'm compiling the official rulings archive for the Magic: The Gathering card Fireball. How many official rulings have ever been issued for Fireball? I need the total across all time, with no date restriction.
cases.evidence: A ruling is an official clarification issued by Wizards of the Coast about how a card works.

cases.question: Which card whose original type is 'Creature - Elf' has received the most rulings, and how many rulings has it received? I want the card name and the number of rulings. A card and all of its printings/reprints count as one and the same card. If several cards tie for the most rulings, list every one of them.
cases.evidence: A ruling is an official rules clarification issued for a card, on the date it was issued.

cases.question: I'm reviewing the very first cards in the database and want to compare how widely accepted white cards are versus black cards across play formats. For each card color that appears among the cards with ID 1 through 20, please tell me the card color and the number of play formats in which cards of that color are legal. A card only counts as legal in a format if its legality status for that format is 'Legal' - banned or restricted doesn't count.
cases.evidence: Formats of play: the game formats a card is permitted in, such as commander or vintage.

cases.question: I'm tracking John Avon's artwork. Among his cards that exist as powerful foils, what is the most recent frame year, and how many of those cards carry it? If several years are tied for most recent, give each year with its own count. Match John Avon on the illustrator's name.
cases.evidence: powerful foil: a card whose Card Kingdom identifiers are both present – the regular identifier and the foil identifier.

cases.question: I play paper Magic and I'm building a pauper deck. How many printings of cards illustrated by Erica Yang are legal in the pauper format and exist as paper (physically printed) cards? I want just a single count of printings, with each printing counted separately.
cases.evidence: Pauper is a Magic: The Gathering format where only common-rarity cards are legal; a printing is a specific physical or digital release of a card in a set; 'legal in pauper' means the card's pauper legality status is Legal; 'paper' means a physical printed card.

cases.question: I keep a Card Kingdom catalogue and want to list the creature cards that Card Kingdom stocks in both foil and non-foil printings. A card counts as stocked in both printings when both its Card Kingdom Foil id and its Card Kingdom id are present. Please give me one row per card, with each card's Card Kingdom Foil id and Card Kingdom id, and nothing else. I only need the three cards with the lowest Card Kingdom Foil ids in alphabetical order, with ties broken by the Card Kingdom id.
cases.evidence: Card Kingdom Foil id: the retailer's identifier for the foil printing; Card Kingdom id: the retailer's identifier for the non-foil printing.

cases.question: Among the cards carrying the boros watermark that were printed in a foreign language, which card type is the most common, and how many of those cards have that type? If several types tie for the most, list all of them with their counts.
cases.evidence: "Boros watermark" refers to the guild watermark appearing on cards of the Boros guild; "printed in a foreign language" means the card was printed in any language other than English.

cases.question: Among the Magic: The Gathering cards whose watermark is one of the ten Ravnica guild symbols (Azorius, Boros, Dimir, Golgari, Gruul, Izzet, Orzhov, Rakdos, Selesnya, Simic), which guild has the most cards that were printed in another language, and how many of that guild's cards is that? If several guilds tie for the most, give me each tied guild along with the number.
cases.evidence: A Ravnica guild is the guild a card's watermark belongs to; a card 'printed in another language' is a card that exists in a language edition other than English.

cases.question: I'm cataloguing the guild cards. Among the cards that carry the Azorius watermark and were printed in at least one foreign language, how many cards are there of each card type? For each card type, please give me the card type exactly as printed, including any supertypes and subtypes, along with the number of cards of that type. List every card type that qualifies, sorted from the largest count to the smallest, and alphabetically by card type when counts are equal.
I'm cataloguing modern-frame printings. How many different cards that have a text box were printed with a frame version of 2015 or a later year? I just need that single count.
cases.evidence: Frame version: the version of the card frame style, given as the year the frame style was introduced.

cases.question: I'm putting together a showcase of promotional cards and need a list of card names. I want the names of the cards that have a promotional printing and have multiple faces on the same card, but only those printed in the most recent card frame version. A card's frame version is the year its frame style was introduced, so the most recent frame version is the one with the latest year - and it should be the newest frame style overall, not just among promotional multi-faced cards. Please list each card's name once.
cases.evidence: A promotional printing is a printing of a card that was given out for promotional purposes. A card with multiple faces has multiple faces printed on the same card.

cases.question: I'm putting together a retrospective of promotional cards. Can you get me the card name of every promotional card that has multiple faces printed on it (like split, transform, or adventure cards) and was originally released in 2019? By "originally released" I mean the card's own first-release date, not the release date of the set its promotional printing belongs to, and "in 2019" means January 1 through December 31, 2019. If a card has more than one promotional printing from that year, list it just once. I only want the card names, nothing else.

I'm researching printings of the Magic: The Gathering card Tarmogoyf. I want to identify every reprint of Tarmogoyf that was published in a card frame style that was already at least 10 full years old when the set came out. Please give me the set name and release date of every set that qualifies, not just one. Two rules: the frame version is the year that frame style dates from (the frame style itself, not any frame artwork effects), and 'at least 10 full years' is inclusive, measured between the frame version's year and the set's release year.
cases.evidence: Frame version: the year the card frame style of a printing dates from.

cases.question: I'm cataloguing European releases of Counterspell. How many of its printings were released with both a French and an Italian localization? I just need the count as a single number.
cases.evidence: A printing is one release of the card identified by its set and its card number in that set; 'Counterspell' is the English card name as catalogued.

cases.question: I'm putting together a localization report. Find the sets that belong to the same expansion type as "From the Vault: Lore" – include that set itself if it qualifies. Among those, which sets never received a name in any foreign language? For each one, give me the set's name and its release date. List each qualifying set once, from the earliest release date to the latest. Don't include anything else.
cases.evidence: Expansion type means the category a set belongs to, such as core, expansion or masters.

cases.question: Which set contains the Aven Mindcensor printing that uses the newest card frame? I want the set's name and its release date. Count every printing, including promotional and online-only ones. If several printings share the newest frame, use the most recently released one; if the release dates tie too, list each such set once. Please give me the set name, not its code.
cases.evidence: Frame version: the frame style used for a printing; frame styles are identified by the year that style was introduced.

cases.question: I'm auditing which recent products were never localized for Spanish-speaking markets. Can you find every set released in calendar year 2020 that has no Spanish name? For each of those, I just need the set code and the set's release date.
cases.evidence: By "Spanish name" I mean the Spanish-language version of a set's name.

cases.question: I'm cataloguing special-release printings illustrated by Rob Alexander. What is the total converted mana cost across all cards illustrated by Rob Alexander whose original release falls in 2013? Please give me just that total as a single number. By 'released in 2013' I mean the calendar year from 1 January through 31 December 2013, and a card's original release is the original release date recorded on the card itself—cards with no original release date recorded are out of scope. Each card printing counts separately in the total.
cases.evidence: Converted mana cost: the total numeric mana value of a card, e.g. a card costing {4}{W}{W} has a converted mana cost of 6.

cases.question: We're planning translation work for upcoming set releases and want to know how extensively a recent release year was localized. What was the average number of languages in which sets released in 2016 had their names translated? By 'released in 2016' I mean the release date falls within calendar year 2016. Every set released in 2016 counts toward the average, including any whose names were translated into no language at all (those count as zero). A language counts for a set when the set's name is rendered in that language. Please give me just that one number, rounded to two decimals.
cases.evidence: Set name translation: the set's name rendered in another language.
